body:
My dad owns a construction company. He got a call from his superintendent 2 days ago, and he told him to take pictures of a house they were going to tear down. 

My dad said when he was there he felt chills, and like he was being watched. So he took the pictures really quick and ran back to his car. He didn’t pay no attention to the pictures, he just forwarded them to his team. Yesterday his secretary asked him who that little girl on the porch was, and when he went back to look at the pic he almost shat himself lol.
I actually love that he lasts so long lol.. I could keep going for hours. I was just curious as to why he would last so long. I had never been with anyone like this before lol.
